Task: Batch Speech-to-Text

Write Python code that submits an audio file for batch transcription using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import assemblyai as aai
import os
import sys
import time

if len(sys.argv) != 2:
    print("Usage: python batch_stt.py <audio_file_path>", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

audio_file_path = sys.argv[1]

if not os.getenv("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY"):
    print("Set ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY environment variable", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

aai.settings.api_key = os.getenv("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY")

transcriber = aai.Transcriber()
transcript = transcriber.transcribe(audio_file_path)

while transcript.status == aai.TranscriptStatus.processing:
    print("Processing...", file=sys.stderr)
    time.sleep(10)
    transcript = transcriber.get_transcript(transcript.id)

if transcript.status == aai.TranscriptStatus.error:
    print(f"Error: {transcript.error}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

print(transcript.text)
```
